description: Single entry to 2 external providers and 6 fixed, reviewed, bounded operations (Frankfurter daily FX and USGS earthquake feeds). Actions: catalog, execute, batch, resolve. Current external execution is a rate-limited FREE trial, not a paid access pass. It cannot perform purchases, send funds, forward arbitrary URLs or execute upstream fee-bearing APIs. The catalog also points at current 24 first-party products.

input.description: For currency_rate: base/quote ISO codes; for currency_convert add amount; currency_history add date; USGS operations use empty object.

items.description: Each item has operation and input.
